source_text: If we need to wait for futon1b to complete in order for the roload to work, the stepper should retry after a wait.  Possibly we should develop an "r r" pattern or "r R" pattern, which would make the interaction a little bit like Magit, to show the possible rewind, then rewind it.  Naturally this plays havoc with things like .json files so we might need to be *storing* the 象 data in futon1b so we can use XT tricks to rewind.  Another fun feature would be to rewind the REPL buffer (though I think we'd want to keep the turns both from operator and agent, just mark them retired)
